decisions.reason: Copper-coated glass packaging substrates under the ACT platform are a flagship aligned with the firm's push into higher-value 3D integration and high-frequency applications, and glass substrates are a growing semiconductor packaging trend.

VLIS was launched in 2024 with its own dedicated page as a next-generation through-glass via technology, and it complements Product A in the firm's strategic growth direction, so dropping it within a year is very unlikely.
